subject.title: fix(acp): keep completed run-mode sessions resumable

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally retain completed ACP run-mode metadata and allow later parent follow-ups when resume support, stable resolved identity, completed-turn readiness, persistence, and backend ownership are all confirmed?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but this is an intentional compatibility and session-lifecycle boundary that requires ACP owner acceptance and direct dependency-contract confirmation.

options.title: Adopt guarded resume
options.body: Rebase and merge after an ACP owner confirms the Codex and ACPX identifier contracts and preserves every capability, identity, persistence, backend-pinning, and fail-closed guard.

options.title: Keep one-shots terminal
options.body: Preserve unconditional cleanup and leave completed run-mode follow-ups unsupported if one-shot metadata must disappear permanently.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded resume
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge after an ACP owner confirms the Codex and ACPX identifier contracts and preserves every capability, identity, persistence, backend-pinning, and fail-closed guard.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-main history signal is on the task-maintenance lifecycle boundary controlling terminal ACP cleanup.
